facts: Attached Gothic bell tower, rectangular plan with rough masonry fields and ashlar corners, four registers divided by stringcourses, pointed belfry openings on all four faces, and crenellated top.
Two towers, an upper loft, 18th-century iron balconies, irregular lower windows, two pointed entrances and the founder’s armorial roundel.
South wing church with a single nave, side buttressing and a gabled roof structure.
Four double-storey gallery walks, seven bays per face with additional corner vaults, low brick Gothic/Mudéjar arches and contrasting upper stonework.
Bare earth ground survey provided alongside a normalized separate building model. The exact original WCS crop files are retained for the floor and section controls.
